name: budabit-calendar-widget
description: BudaBit inline widget for featuring community calendar events

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.manifest:after: node $(realpath node_modules/budabit-sdk/dist/manifest/cli.js) --title 'Featured Calendar Events' --type tool --app-url ${WIDGET_APP_URL:-https://example.com/budabit-calendar-widget/index.html} --icon 'https://blossom.budabit.club/daad5d8b18f221978a1609b2eefa511254c703b5914beda9184e6226b6527e18.svg' --image 'https://blossom.budabit.club/daad5d8b18f221978a1609b2eefa511254c703b5914beda9184e6226b6527e18.svg' --identifier 'featured-calendar-event' --version '0.2.14' --changelog 'Fix calendar discovery, dates, navigation, and edit conflicts' --permissions 'community:checkWriteCapabilities,community:queryEvents,community:querySharedConfig,community:publishSharedConfig,ui:toast,ui:navigate,ui:resize' --shared-config 'budabit-calendar-widget=featured-calendar-event' --slot-type 'community-home-after-quicklinks' --slot-label 'Featured events' --output 'dist/widget-after'
scripts.manifest:before: node $(realpath node_modules/budabit-sdk/dist/manifest/cli.js) --title 'Featured Calendar Events' --type tool --app-url ${WIDGET_APP_URL:-https://example.com/budabit-calendar-widget/index.html} --icon 'https://blossom.budabit.club/daad5d8b18f221978a1609b2eefa511254c703b5914beda9184e6226b6527e18.svg' --image 'https://blossom.budabit.club/daad5d8b18f221978a1609b2eefa511254c703b5914beda9184e6226b6527e18.svg' --identifier 'featured-calendar-event' --version '0.2.14' --changelog 'Fix calendar discovery, dates, navigation, and edit conflicts' --permissions 'community:checkWriteCapabilities,community:queryEvents,community:querySharedConfig,community:publishSharedConfig,ui:toast,ui:navigate,ui:resize' --shared-config 'budabit-calendar-widget=featured-calendar-event' --slot-type 'community-home-before-quicklinks' --slot-label 'Featured events' --output 'dist/widget-before'
